main_text.p: proficisci nullo modo possint: (iis enim rebus per fidem & mundus vincitur, & diabolus fugatur, & caro mortificatur) Euangelij veritatem confirmant, donec Christus visibiliter iterum veniat, & habitet in Ecclesia, eaque ratione omnem dubitationem, si qua reliqua fuerit, ei prorsus eximat. Non modò igitur nobis fauet grammatica, sed etiam res ipsa, quæ nullo modo pati potest ut de missione cuiusdam angeli, aut alterius quàm Christi, verba ista intelligantur.

page.notes: Woodcut ornament below the text, a vase or bowl of flowers and fruit on a pedestal, flanked by two animals (possibly hounds or lions), not transcribed as text. Google "Digitized by Google" watermark at lower right is excluded. The page number is printed as "291" at the top right. The "(iis" was printed "(ijs"; spelling changed per the u/i and i/j rule.
